name: ServerUI Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 self-hosted web server-management panel with SSH terminal, SFTP file manager, multi-server monitoring and encrypted stored credentials; no software quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Requires your own servers, SSH access and web deployment infrastructure (Docker, Go backend and PostgreSQL); no free VPS or hosted compute included. Web terminal and stored SSH credentials are security-sensitive; restrict access and review deployment hardening. Desktop edition is separate.
